name: Honey Select 2
summary: Photorealistic 3D character-creation and Studio Neo adult sandbox built for high-detail posing, lighting, and PCVR viewing.
ranking_rationale: Powerful photoreal 3D posing and lighting toolkit for creators and VR tinkerers; actual gameplay story loop is minimal outside Studio Neo and VR mods.

pricing.notes: Distributed digitally via Japanese storefronts (DLSite / DMM) and international community modpacks.

pros: Detailed photorealistic character sliders, shaders, and skin textures
Studio Neo lets enthusiasts stage custom animations, props, and camera paths
Community BetterRepack & VR plugin suite adds full PCVR and haptic sync
cons: Minimal actual game loop outside dress-up and scene staging
Original Japanese licensing and third-party patch setup adds friction

image.alt: Honey Select 2 logo and brand card

facts.value: Studio Neo scene builder + community VR / haptic plugins
Follow-up to Honey Select, expanded via community mod ecosystems
